'''Sam Lee''' of Kaysville, Utah, was a finalist in Decipher's 1997 Design a Card contest and received two [[Special Edition]] booster packs.<ref name="win">[http://www.decipher.com/insidedecipher/archives/1997/designawinner.html Guy Kargl Wins Star Wars CCG Card Design Contest], Rich Loftus, Decipher (23 May 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990210055006/http://www.decipher.com/insidedecipher/archives/1997/designawinner.html Internet Archive]</ref>
